reports.title: Severe Deep Pothole on 100ft Road intersection
reports.description: A dangerous 2-foot wide crater has formed right after the rain near 12th Main junction. Two scooter riders almost slipped this morning. Urgent patching required before peak traffic.

location.address: 100ft Inner Ring Road, near 12th Main Signal, Indiranagar

reports.audioTranscript: Large pothole about two feet across near twelfth main signal. Water has accumulated inside making it hard for two wheelers to see at night.

aiAnalysis.priorityReason: Keywords "deep crater", "scooter riders slipped", "peak traffic" indicate imminent pedestrian and commuter accident risk.
aiAnalysis.summary: Hazardous 2-foot pothole at 100ft Ring Road intersection causing vehicle skidding; requires cold mix bituminous filling.

timeline.title: Issue Lodged by Citizen
timeline.description: Vandhana Vijayakumar reported the road crater with live GPS location & photo.

timeline.title: AI Verification & Triage
timeline.description: AI classified as Damaged Roads with 94% confidence. High Priority assigned.

timeline.title: Assigned to Ward Engineer
timeline.description: Dispatched to Rajesh Kumar (PWD Ward 82). Inspection schedule created.

timeline.title: Road Maintenance Crew on Site
timeline.description: Cold-mix asphalt truck dispatched. Safety cones placed around work zone.

reports.title: Cluster of 4 Broken LED Streetlights creating Dark Corridor
reports.description: Four consecutive streetlights on 5th Cross residential lane have been completely dead for 5 days. Women and elderly residents feel unsafe walking back from the bus stop after 7 PM.

location.address: 5th Cross Road, Near Community Park, Koramangala 4th Block

aiAnalysis.priorityReason: Non-functioning street illumination over multiple poles in residential neighborhood posing public safety concerns.
aiAnalysis.summary: 4 dead streetlights along 5th Cross corridor; potential feeder line or photocell switch breakdown.

resolution.resolutionNotes: Field team inspected the feeder pillar on Pole #12. The master timer switch and burnt surge fuse were replaced. All 4 72W LED fixtures tested and operational with automatic dusk-to-dawn sensors.

timeline.title: Report Submitted
timeline.description: Vandhana Vijayakumar highlighted dark walking hazard on 5th Cross.

timeline.title: Assigned to Lighting Inspector
timeline.description: Assigned to Priya Sundaram. Service vehicle dispatched.

timeline.title: Cable Fault Isolation
timeline.description: Feeder line test in progress with hydraulic ladder truck.

timeline.title: Lights Replaced & Tested
timeline.description: All 4 street lamps illuminated. Evidence photo uploaded. Awaiting citizen confirmation.

reports.title: Overflowing Community Waste Dumpster attracting Stray Animals
reports.description: The municipal bin at 80ft Road Vegetable Market has not been cleared for 3 days. Trash is spilling across the sidewalk, blocking pedestrian movement and creating severe hygiene issues.

location.address: 80 Feet Road, Near Daily Fresh Mart, HAL 2nd Stage

aiAnalysis.priorityReason: High organic waste accumulation near food market; risk of disease vectors and blocked walkway.
aiAnalysis.summary: Commercial area dumpster overflow causing sidewalk obstruction and sanitation risk.

timeline.title: Report Received
timeline.description: Citizen reported waste spill near vegetable market.

reports.title: Drinking Water Pipeline Burst gushing water on main road
reports.description: High pressure drinking water pipe has ruptured near 14th Main cross. Clean water is flowing in torrents, creating artificial waterlogging and eroding the road surface foundation.

location.landmark: Near BDA Complex water tank junction

aiAnalysis.priorityReason: Potable water loss, torrential volume, and structural road foundation erosion warrant immediate valve closure.
aiAnalysis.summary: Main supply pipe rupture leaking clean municipal water; valve isolation and collar clamp needed.

resolution.resolutionNotes: Emergency pipeline crew shut the feeder sluice valve #8. A 300mm cracked ductile iron pipe section was cut and replaced with mechanical joint coupling. Road surface leveled and cleared.
resolution.citizenFeedback: Super fast response! The water flow stopped within 2 hours and the crew cleanly patched the dug up trench.

timeline.title: Emergency Valve Isolated
timeline.description: Water board technicians closed sector branch valve.

timeline.title: Pipe Repaired & Pressure Tested
timeline.description: Ductile iron sleeve welded. Water supply restored.

timeline.title: Citizen Confirmed Resolution
timeline.description: Vandhana inspected the site and awarded 5-star rating.

reports.title: Exposed live wire hanging from low transformer fence
reports.description: High voltage wire hanging down to 4 feet off the pavement right beside an elementary school gate. Sparks noticed when dry tree branch touched it.

location.address: Near St. Mary School, 3rd Block, Jayanagar

aiAnalysis.priorityReason: CRITICAL SAFETY HAZARD: Live electrical cable within children reach next to school gate with reported sparking.
aiAnalysis.summary: Hanging live conductor near school posing high risk of electrocution; power shutdown and re-stringing required immediately.

timeline.title: Hazard Reported
timeline.description: Citizen flagged exposed electrical wire near school.

timeline.title: Priority Auto-Escalation
timeline.description: System identified school proximity; auto-escalated to Emergency Electrical Patrol.

comments.message: Thanks for sending the crew so quickly! Please also check the corner of 13th cross as another crack is starting to form.
Noted Vandhana. Our patch roller is on site, we will reinforce that joint as well before sealing.
Work completed and lamps powered on. Citizen Vandhana, please verify if the illumination level is satisfactory on your evening walk.
